versions.changelog:
- Adds detailed documentation for generating AI images using over 50 models via inference.sh CLI.
- Model list expanded: now includes FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, and others with app IDs and best-use cases.
- Now supports a wide range of capabilities: text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA, image editing, upscaling, and text rendering.
- Includes quick start guide, practical CLI usage examples, and links to related AI image and video generation skills.
- Improved trigger coverage for easier discovery (e.g., ai image, midjourney alternative, text2img).
- Documentation now links to in-depth guides and installation verification resources.

- Initial release of the ai-image-generation skill.
- Generate AI images using over 50 models via inference.sh CLI, including FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, and Reve.
- Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA, image editing, upscaling, and text rendering.
- Includes usage examples and model list for quick start and reference.
- Provides links to detailed documentation and related skills for expanded AI image workflows.
